title: MOTION (LEE - BLUMENFIELD) and RESOLUTION relative to issuing and reissuing one or more series of bonds in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed…
text:
[Council File 26-1604; CD 12]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (LEE - BLUMENFIELD) and RESOLUTION relative to issuing and reissuing one or more series of bonds in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $45,000,000 to finance and/or refinance the acquisition, construction, improvement, renovation, furnishing, and equipping of a 206-unit multifamily affordable housing project known as 8350 Reseda Blvd. (Project), located at 8350 Reseda Boulevard in Council District 12.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. CONSIDER the results of the Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA) public hearing held on September 21, 2026 for the Project.
2. ADOPT the accompanying TEFRA RESOLUTION, to allow the California Municipal Finance Authority to issue and/or reissue one or more series of bonds in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $45,000,000 to finance and/or refinance the acquisition, construction, improvement, renovation, furnishing, and equipping of a 206-unit multifamily affordable housing project located at 8350 Reseda Boulevard in Council District 12.
